# §14-7.2. Congressional Districts - Divisions.
The State of Oklahoma is hereby divided into five (5) Congressional Districts as described in this section. The following delineation of areas to be included in each Congressional District is based on the official Counties, Voting Tabulation Districts (VTD) and Census Blocks (Block) as defined in 2020 by the United States Bureau of the Census. The five (5) Congressional Districts shall consist of the Counties, Voting Tabulation Districts (VTD) and Census Blocks (Block) described as follows:
